purpose: Convert low-cost prospective source pins into auditable feature-source and outcome-source eligibility without backfilling later AlphaDojo vintages into earlier signal dates.

strict_signal_boundary.reason: V2.8.3 confirmatory contract and execution mechanics were frozen after the 2026-09-21 market session.

pin_observation_authority.rule: The authoritative observation time of a source-pin receipt is the committed_at timestamp of the first Git commit that created that exact pin file.
pin_observation_authority.reason: Permit normal post-close vendor publication latency while preventing later historical backfill from being treated as D-vintage information.

exact_materialization.download: Materialize each tracked data.parquet with hf_hub_download(repo_type=dataset, revision=frozen revision_sha).
exact_materialization.byte_gate: Downloaded file SHA256 must exactly equal frozen target_lfs_sha256.

requires: signal_date is a frozen joint A-share trading day
pin authoritative observation time <= D+1 23:59:59 Asia/Shanghai
CSI300 has enough source history through D to compute the frozen 60-return market state
no source/PIT integrity blocker is active

outcome_source_gate.target_dates: Frozen D+5 and D+10 joint A-share trading dates determined at signal admission.
outcome_source_gate.pending_rule: If an exact retained T-vintage containing the target date has not yet been prospectively pinned/materialized, outcome status is OUTCOME_PENDING, not failure.
outcome_source_gate.same_vintage_endpoint_rule: For each horizon, both D close and target T close must be read from the same exact retained T-vintage stock parquet.

problem_elimination.delete: Do not download full parquet during routine metadata capture.
problem_elimination.avoid: Do not infer D-vintage eligibility from a later current snapshot.
problem_elimination.absorb: Use Git/Hugging Face immutable identities and existing V2.7.32 joint-calendar semantics.
problem_elimination.substitute: Represent not-yet-mature forward outcomes explicitly as OUTCOME_PENDING instead of rerunning statistics.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Reuse Hugging Face cache by immutable revision/LFS identity.
